text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: "...Ah, a stamina recovery item dropped. I still have time, maybe I should use it...?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, geez, you.
I told you to stop shouting my name so loud every single time.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, so sorry, so sorry!! But listen, listen,
something super funny just happened!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, hold on a sec...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? Wh-What's this all of a sudden!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You actually put your phone away mid-game
just to listen to what I have to say?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm zzooo moveddddd!!! You really
started to enjoy chatting a little bit, didn't youuuu?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"N-No, wait, this is...!!
Ah, damn it...!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Lately, I feel like I've been able to
communicate really well with Narita Taishin."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, I was intending to discuss training again today, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll just listen like this today.
Go ahead and say whatever you want."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Don't 'huh' me! I said I'm listening right like this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Narita Taishin seemed
unusually embarrassed for some reason.
